claims.claim: Revenue for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 was $90.0 billion.
Quarterly revenue increased 18% compared to the same period last year.
Quarterly revenue increased 17% in constant currency.
Operating income was $40.6 billion for the quarter.
Operating income increased 18% over the prior year.
Net income was $35.8 billion on a GAAP basis.
GAAP net income increased 31%.
Net income was $35.3 billion on a non-GAAP basis.
Non-GAAP net income increased 22%.
Diluted earnings per share were $4.81 on a GAAP basis.
GAAP diluted earnings per share increased 32%.
Diluted earnings per share were $4.74 on a non-GAAP basis.
Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share increased 23%.
Full-year revenue for the period ended June 30, 2026 was $331.8 billion.
Full-year revenue was up 18%.
Full-year revenue was up 16% in constant currency.
Microsoft Cloud revenue reached $59.3 billion.
Microsoft Cloud revenue was up 27% year-over-year.
Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%.
Productivity and Business Processes revenue was $37.8 billion, up 14%.
Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 14% on a reported basis.
Intelligent Cloud revenue was $39.3 billion, up 32% (31% in constant currency).
More Personal Computing revenue was $12.9 billion, a decrease of 4% (down 5% in constant currency).
The company will provide forward-looking guidance during the earnings conference call and webcast.
The company returned $10.2 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026.
Total assets as of June 30, 2026 were $758.3 billion.
claims.note: Balance sheet shows total assets of $758,376 million, which rounds to $758.4 billion at the precision used; $758.3 billion is a truncation, not a correct rounding.

claims.claim: Total cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments were $76.8 billion as of June 30, 2026.
Investments in OpenAI resulted in a $480 million increase in net income and a $0.07 increase in diluted earnings per share for the fourth quarter on a non-GAAP basis.
claims.note: Basis is inverted. The release states the $480 million and $0.07 net gains impacted reported (GAAP) net income and diluted EPS; the non-GAAP measures exclude these amounts, which is why non-GAAP net income ($35,286M) and EPS ($4.74) are lower than GAAP ($35,766M and $4.81). The figures and period are right, but they are not a non-GAAP basis increase.

claims.claim: There was a $3.2 billion gain from the investment in Anthropic in the quarter.
There were lower-than-expected expenses related to the Voluntary Retirement Program.
These items contributed to a $0.27 benefit on diluted earnings per share compared to prior guidance.
